{"code": "import numpy as np

# Impute missing values (i.e., -999.0) with the mean of valid values
mean_valid = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Create a copy of the data with imputed values
df_imputed = df.copy()
df_imputed.loc[df_imputed['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0, 'biomarker_baseline'] = mean_valid

# Compute the mean across all patients, now with imputed values
mean_baseline_imputed = df_imputed['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f'Imputed mean baseline biomarker value (using mean of valid values): {mean_baseline_imputed:.3f} ng/mL')"}
